items.t: — Bloomberg puts the Gareth Penny consortium's price for Anglo American's 85% stake at about $1 billion: roughly $750 million on closing and $250 million deferred, with some $500 million of working capital going in behind it, against a book value of about $2.3 billion earlier this year

— Spot recovered to about $4,074.98 an ounce, up 0.22% on the day and 23.84% on the year, erasing Wednesday's post-FOMC slip to $4,029; the market unwound a hawkish hold with three dissents in a single session

— Platinum rose to $1,628.20 an ounce and palladium 2.51% to $1,284.00, reversing Wednesday's cooling; platinum is 26.13% higher year on year with a fourth straight annual supply deficit still forecast

— TAGS cleared 95% of a Luanda tender of rough above 10.8 carats and called it a return to near normal trading, while Sodiam's seventeenth auction took about $21.7 million net from 6,586.89 carats, 23.46% above expected value

— First-half sales rose 47% to more than $1.41 billion, the highest midyear total in the firm's fifty years; its May 4 jewelry auction made $9,713,640, led by a 6.59-carat Kashmir sapphire at $906,250

items.b: FOUR SWISS GROUPS IN THE BLACK
items.t: — Morgan Stanley's second-quarter secondary index rose 1.5% and all four groups it tracks are positive year on year for the first time since early 2022, Swatch Group up 5.4% and Richemont 4.2%

— Platinum Guild International USA announced that senior vice president Kevin Reilly retired at the end of June after twenty years there and thirty-nine in the trade; global platinum jewellery demand is forecast to contract 6% in 2026

items.b: THE SHOP THAT WAS NEVER THERE
items.t: — AI-built jewellery storefronts are running fabricated closing-down and bereavement sales at 80% to 90% off with scraped product photography and synthetic voiceovers; buyers report receiving resin, plastic and plated metal, or nothing

— ICA members report colored-stone demand roughly 30% below 2022 even as Mahenge spinel holds a 150% post-pandemic gain and Mozambican Paraiba trades at $10,000 to $12,000 a carat; tsavorite has given back 15% to 20% in a year

tape_ts: 30 Jul 2026, European session · gold recovers the Fed
